description.zh:
个人访问令牌。 
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
description.en:
Personal access token.  
This field is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret or temporary authorization from Security Token Service (STS).

description.zh: 文件开始行，若为空，则取文件全部内容
description.en: Starting line of the file. If empty, the entire file content is retrieved.

description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

description.zh: 分支名称、标签名称或者提交的版本号
description.en: Branch name, tag name, or commit version number

description.zh: 文件结束行，且只有在from不为空时才有意义
description.en: Ending line of the file. This parameter is valid only when from is not empty.
